mutants.name: cap-removed
mutants.why: removing the cap returns all section lines; a3 expects exactly 40 and the truncation marker

mutants.name: except-reraises
mutants.why: re-raising instead of fail-open makes _standing_constraints crash on OSError; a2 expects None on every failure
mutants.anchor:
except Exception:  # fail-open (standing constraints)
        return None

mutants.name: heading-dropped

mutants.name: composer-drops-constraints

mutants.name: main-forces-none
